title: Trump said he would dine with Anthropic CEO amid mounting AI debate
description: President Donald Trump had plans to dine late Sunday with the CEO of Anthropic. Dario Amodei is one of the leading voices on artificial intelligence but also someone who’s sparred with the administration over the military’s potential use of AI. The meal comes just two days after Amodei’s company faced a setback in a court case against the government over its barring its products for defense work. Amodei had concerns the company’s products could be used for mass surveillance or autonomous armed drones. Amodei has also said the artificial-intelligence industry should slow its fast-moving development to give safety measures time to catch up.
